mapper.update: update courseselection set score = #{score},status = #{status} where student_id=#{studentId} AND course_id=#{courseId} AND semester_id=#{semesterId}
mapper.select: select student_id from courseselection where student_id=#{studentId} AND course_id=#{courseId}
SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM courseselection ORDER BY student_id

SELECT cs.student_id AS studentId, cs.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, c.credits, cs.score, cs.semester_id AS semester FROM courseselection cs JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.course_id JOIN teachingplan tp ON cs.course_id = tp.course_id AND cs.semester_id = tp.semester_id AND tp.major_code = ( SELECT cl.major_code FROM student s JOIN class cl ON s.class_id = cl.class_id WHERE s.user_id = #{studentId} ) WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.semester_id = #{semesterId} ORDER BY cs.course_id;

SELECT cs.student_id AS studentId, cs.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, c.credits, cs.score, cs.semester_id AS semester FROM courseselection cs JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.course_id JOIN teachingplan tp ON cs.course_id = tp.course_id AND cs.semester_id = tp.semester_id AND tp.major_code = ( SELECT cl.major_code FROM student s JOIN class cl ON s.class_id = cl.class_id WHERE s.user_id = #{studentId} ) WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND tp.course_category IN ('必修','选修') ORDER BY cs.course_id;

SELECT cs.student_id AS studentId, cs.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, c.credits, cs.score, cs.semester_id AS semester FROM courseselection cs JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.course_id JOIN teachingplan tp ON cs.course_id = tp.course_id AND cs.semester_id = tp.semester_id AND tp.major_code = ( SELECT cl.major_code FROM student s JOIN class cl ON s.class_id = cl.class_id WHERE s.user_id = #{studentId} ) WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND tp.course_category = '必修' ORDER BY cs.course_id;
